description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the Drug class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing methods related to adding drug reference maps and ensuring duplicates are not added.

classes.name: DrugTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the Drug class functionalities in OpenMRS.

methods.name: addDrugReferenceMap_shouldSetDrugAsTheDrugToWhichAMappingIsBeingAdded
methods.description: Tests that adding a DrugReferenceMap to a Drug sets the proper reference within the map.

methods.name: addDrugReferenceMap_shouldShouldNotAddDuplicateDrugReferenceMaps
methods.description: Ensures that duplicate DrugReferenceMaps are not added to a Drug.
